verdict.rationale: Check documents a dedicated sandbox environment, separate from production, for experimenting with API calls without affecting real companies or employees. It also documents sandbox-specific simulation tools, such as magic routing numbers for bank failures and testing of the full rejection lifecycle. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, explicit docs on connecting the MCP server/CLI to sandbox vs production, details on sandbox data seeding/reset.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Experiment with API calls without affecting real companies or employees
This lets you test the full rejection lifecycle and verify your integration handles both the retryable and terminal states.
Use routing number `000000000` to simulate a disabled bank account in sandbox, or `111111111` to simulate failure for both company and employee accounts.
